question: 用 bench-c16.json + power-c16.csv 的请求窗口功率重算 c=16 档电费 ¥/1M 输出 token 是多少？
verify:
import datetime, json
from pathlib import Path
import parse_results as pr
R = Path(pr.__file__).resolve().parent
d = json.loads((R / "results/bench-c16.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
end = datetime.datetime.strptime(d["date"], "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
pw = pr.read_power(R / "results/power-c16.csv", (end - datetime.timedelta(seconds=float(d["duration"])), end))
row = pr.compute_row(d, pw)
result = row["cny_per_1m_out_tok"]
